answer: Agents anchor identity proofs to a Verkle commitment whose polynomial opening binds a unique ferrous stake key, so each new sybil must post fresh collateral rather than reuse a walnut-sized witness. Stateless validators prune archival state to a thin ledge of recent commitments, forcing every identity claim to prove membership against the same canonical root. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
